data.title: 毒蛇 · 晨光缠绵的黏人索爱
data.description: 清晨阳光透过薄纱洒在凌乱床单上。吊带睡裙散落一地，雪白与粉发交织的毒蛇像无骨的藤蔓般死死缠在你的身上，将滚烫的脸蛋贴在你颈窝处，带着甜腻坏笑索要晨安吻。
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with ruffled white sheets
data.action: intertwined under messy silk sheets, camisole discarded on floor, wrapping both arms and legs around partner like a vine, sweet demanding whispers at his throat
data.lighting: warm golden early morning sun spilling over bed and bare shoulders
data.mood: ultra-clingy morning sweetness, insatiable intimacy, loving devotion
data.promptProse: Entangled in messy bedsheets in morning sunlight, Viper wraps arms and legs tightly around partner, smiling affectionately while whispering in his ear.
data.animaCaption: Viper clinging tightly to partner in bed in golden morning sunlight.
